overlaps.rationale: A building is the constructed structure, while a building floor is one level within that structure; Indonesian and Malaysian answers also differ.
A floor tile is an individual flooring unit, whereas a building floor is a complete level of a multi-storey building.
A balcony is an outdoor platform extending from an upper floor, not the floor level itself; both answer pairs differ.
A railway platform is a raised passenger-waiting area, a different sense from a building floor; the answer pairs differ.
